This tracked WIP diagnostic study promotes the interrupted mass-injecting growth campaign into the same collaborator-facing study shape used by the completed studies.
The study remains exploratory and forensic: some cases were manually interrupted after ETA review, some failed before shutdown, and four partial runs retained unreadable HDF5/XDMF field files.
The promoted root keeps the surviving per-run montage/video artifacts where they exist and preserves the failed/interrupted status explicitly in the overall analysis and comparison pages.
Use this study together with the completed canonical-disk-growth-campaign study to discuss what transfers cleanly from kinematic growth and what breaks under source-driven mass addition.
